AI Image Generation Prompt Book contains 100+ professional prompts across 7 categories, complete with technical parameters and style references.

  • Social Media — Instagram posts, LinkedIn banners, Twitter headers
  • Creative & Artistic — Concept art, illustrations, abstract designs
  • Website & UI — Hero images, backgrounds, icon sets
  • Seasonal & Campaign — Holiday themes, promotional graphics
  • Product Photography — E-commerce images, lifestyle shots
  • Technical Reference — Aspect ratios, style modifiers, quality parameters
